lines.en: label sarasummer2noongen:
scene sarasummer2noongen
I call Sara and the two of us make plans to meet at her bar and go for a walk around the neighborhood before her shift begins.
lines.zh: 我打给 Sara，我俩约好在她酒吧碰头，趁她上班前在附近逛一圈。

lines.en: What I didn’t realize at the time of making these plans is that “a walk around the neighborhood” was more like being dragged around it while she points out various locations she has fond memories of.
lines.zh: 订计划的时候我没意识到，所谓「在附近逛一圈」，其实是被她拽着到处走，一路指给我看那些她留有美好回忆的地方。

lines.en: I wonder if I’d be like that as well if I could properly recollect my past and where I come from.
lines.zh: 我在想，如果我能好好回忆起自己的过去、自己的来处，我是不是也会是那样。

lines.en: In fact, I wish I could. Because even if Sara is refusing to let go of my arm and constantly pulling me in a new direction every two minutes, it seems like she’s having a good time.
lines.zh: 其实我真希望自己能。因为就算 Sara 死死抓着我的胳膊不放、每两分钟就把我拽向一个新方向，她看起来还是很开心。

lines.en: She points to an aqueduct where she broke her leg once and talks about how, in that moment, she believed she was going to die.
lines.zh: 她指着一条引水渠说，她曾在那儿摔断过腿，还说那一刻她以为自己要死了。

lines.en: She tells me all sorts of personal stories, lacing them with grim connotations that sound more like jokes thanks to the way she speaks-
lines.zh: 她跟我讲了各式各样的私事，还掺进阴森森的意味——可配上她说话的方式，听起来倒更像玩笑——

lines.en: And I never pull away my arm, so she’ll still have something to hang on to when she can’t laugh anymore.
lines.zh: 而我从没把手臂抽走，好让她笑不出来的时候，还有东西可以抓。

lines.en: scene black
She takes me down to the aqueduct and almost slips in the process.
lines.zh: 她带我下到引水渠边，中途差点滑倒。

lines.en: I catch her and pull her back to me before she repeats the past and it causes the two of us to fall into the dirt.
lines.zh: 我一把抓住她、把她拉回我这边，才没让她重演历史，害我俩一起摔进土里。

lines.en: She lands on top of me like it’s some sort of scene in a romantic comedy.
lines.zh: 她压在我身上，像极了爱情喜剧里的某个场景。

lines.en: But instead of using the opportunity to either kiss me or blush and apologize for being so clumsy, she just stares into my eyes in silence.
lines.zh: 可她既没趁机亲我，也没红着脸为自己笨手笨脚道歉，只是沉默地盯着我的眼睛。

lines.en: For a moment, I think I see something in them.
lines.zh: 有那么一瞬，我觉得自己看见了什么。

lines.en: But when a bug crawls across her arm and she gets startled out of her trance, whatever it was disappears.
lines.zh: 可等一只虫子爬过她的手臂、把她从出神中吓醒，那东西就消失了。

lines.en: And I walk her home without any idea of whether or not I’ll ever see it again.
lines.zh: 而我送她回了家，完全不知道自己还能不能再看见它。
